description: Live mobile network (HLR) lookups: whether each mobile is live, switched off or dead. Needs a live account (an OAuth sign-in or a tpsc_live_ key). One prepaid dead number check per mobile, two for a US number; numbers that are not mobiles and invalid numbers cost nothing. Same as POST /v1/dead-number.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers, up to 500 per call, for example "+447700900123".

name: check_dead_numbers
title: Check whether mobiles are live (HLR)
